crossRefs.note: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem…
The sun will be no more your light by day; nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be…
Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and…
For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory…

translations.web: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
translations.bsb: If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight,
translations.kjv: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
translations.asv: Behold, even the moon hath no brightness, And the stars are not pure in his sight:
